messages:
Priya (People Ops): hey managers — putting together a tiny "mid-cycle 1:1 snack pack" you can copy/paste for a quick 15m check-in. tl;dr: 3 prompts, 1 progress metric, 1 coaching ask. drop feedback pls.

Asha (Eng Manager): love it. can you add a suggestion for folks who have mixed goals (project + platform work)? always hard to balance in 15m.

Priya (People Ops): yes — added a short framing. here's the micro-list you can paste into a convo. keep it short, use at start of 1:1 or as a closing checklist.

Priya (People Ops): 
```
15m mid-cycle 1:1 template
- 1 quick highlight (30s): what felt most on-track since last check?
- 1 progress metric (30s): choose one measurable signal (deploys, PRs merged, NPS, latency %)
- 1 blocker (1m): what, if removed, would speed things up?
- 1 coaching ask (1-2m): what specific skill/help do you want from me?
- 30s alignment check: how does this work tie to your top OKR this quarter?
Optional: split project vs platform: "Which part of this week was project-focused vs platform-operational?" 
Sample closing: "One thing I will do before next 1:1: [owner action]. One thing I’d like from you: [IC ask]."
```

Jon (SWE): nice. Can we add an "upward feedback" one-liner? people forget to ask for it.

Priya (People Ops): good call. added as a closing line — two micro-phrases you can swap in:
- "What feedback would help you most from me this sprint?"
- "Is there anything I should start/stop/continue doing to make your work smoother?"

Maya (people-ops-bot): Docs published: https://redwood.example/internal/people-ops/midcycle-1on1-snackpack

Asha (Eng Manager): copying into my 1:1 agenda for tomorrow. thanks — this is great :rocket:

Priya (People Ops): sweet — if anyone wants a one-slide printable cheat sheet -> ping me and I’ll drop a PNG.

Jon (SWE): small ask — can we include a line for "quality signal" for teams that track regressions? maybe 1-sentence suggestion so managers can surface it quickly.

Priya (People Ops): added: "Quality signal: call out any regression, flaky test, or user impact in one sentence." Done.

Asha (Eng Manager): perfect. feel free to tag me if you want manager feedback before publishing org-wide.

Maya (people-ops-bot): Reminder: mid-cycle calibration notes due to people-ops by next Friday. Use form: https://redwood.example/internal/forms/midcycle-calibration

Priya (People Ops): noted — thanks all!
